master.definition_en: A lymphoma that arises from the breast. There is no history of extramammary breast lymphoma and ipsilateral axillary lymph node involvement does not exclude the diagnosis of primary breast lymphoma. Most patients present with a painless breast lump. The vast majority of cases are B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphomas. Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, and extranodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma of mucosa associated lymphoid tissue are the most common types of primary non-Hodgkin lymphoma of the breast. Primary Hodgkin lymphoma of the breast is rare.

It is graded by the severity of symptoms which include ovary enlargement, multiple ovarian follicles; ovarian cysts; ascites; and generalized edema. Increased capillary permeability is caused by the vasoactive substances, such as vascular endothelial growth factors, secreted by the overly-stimulated ovaries.

master.definition_en: Chromosome 4q duplication is a chromosome abnormality characterized by an extra copy (duplication) of genetic material on the long arm (q) of chromosome 4. The severity and specific symptoms depend on the size and location of the duplication, and which genes are involved. Features that have been described in some people with chromosome 4q duplication include developmental delay, intellectual disability, behavioral problems, birth defects, and distinctive facial features. Most cases are inherited from an unaffected parent with a chromosomal rearrangement called a balanced translocation. Some cases are not inherited and occur sporadically. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person.

curated.category: 慢性肉芽肿与间质性肺病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 多系统非干酪样坏死性肉芽肿疾病（最常累及双肺与纵隔淋巴结）；半数以上早期患者可自发缓解，但约10%–20%可进展为不可逆肺纤维化呼吸衰竭，累及心脏（心脏结节病）或中枢神经系统者有突发恶性心律失常/猝死风险。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 无症状I期肺门淋巴结肿大常无需用药定期观察即可；出现器官功能受损者一线口服糖皮质激素（泼尼松）联合二线甲氨蝶呤/硫唑嘌呤或三线TNF-α单抗多可有效控制肉芽肿炎症。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021将“间质性肺病和肺结节病”合并统计，未单列结节病独立全球死亡总数；总体归因死亡率较低（约1%–5%，主要死于肺纤维化呼衰或心脏结节病猝死）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列结节病独立死亡统计；GBD框架下中国ILD与肺结节病标化死亡率约0.46/10万，低于全球平均水平。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球患病率约2–60/10万（北欧与非裔人群较高，东亚较低）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国属相对少见病，估算患病率约1–5/10万（多见于20–50岁中青年及中老年女性），因胸部CT体检普及检出增多，需注意与肺结核及淋巴瘤鉴别。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 确诊前必须通过支气管镜超声穿刺活检（EBUS-TBNA）获得病理证据，严格排除肺结核、非结核分枝杆菌及淋巴瘤后方可启动激素（切忌盲目抗结核或直接用激素）
所有确诊患者基线及每年必须复查心电图、超声心动图（必要时心脏MRI/PET-CT）、裂隙灯眼科检查及血钙尿钙，防隐匿性心脏/眼底损害
并发高钙血症者避免过度日晒及盲目大剂量补充维生素D和钙剂

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 抗GM-CSF、抗IL-23以及全新机制Efzofitimod（调节髓系细胞NRP2受体的融合蛋白，已在III期EFZO-FIT肺结节病试验中探索减少激素依赖）和JAK抑制剂（如托法替布）在难治性皮肤/肺结节病中展现出显著缓解肉芽肿活性。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 病因至今不明，缺乏精准无创生物标志物预测哪些患者会自发缓解、哪些会进展为肺纤维化; 2) 长期使用泼尼松导致肥胖、糖尿病、骨质疏松及感染等严重副作用; 3) 心脏结节病早期漏诊率高且猝死风险大。

master.definition_en: Isolated ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum (AFA) is characterized by the presence of single or multiple thin bands of connective tissue between the upper and lower eyelids, preventing full opening of the eye. Several cases have been reported. It can occur sporadically or following an autosomal dominant transmission pattern. In some cases, AFA can be associated with other disorders, such as trisomy 18. The bands should be removed to avoid amblyopia and this can easily be performed in the neonatal period by cutting with tissue scissors.

master.definition_en: A form of autoimmune hepatitis characterized by the features of classic autoimmune hepatitis (i. e. clinical presentation as acute or chronic cryptogenic hepatitis, interface hepatitis on histological examination, elevated serum aspartate aminotransferase and alanine aminotransferase levels, hypergammaglobulinemia/elevated immunoglobulin G, therapeutic response to corticosteroids) in the absence of serum autoantibodies. Clinical manifestations include fatigue, malaise, arthralgia, jaundice, at later stages also signs of advanced chronic liver disease, such as spider nevi, caput medusae, splenomegaly, ascites, and palmar erythema. Presence of concurrent autoimmune diseases is frequently observed.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.name_en: Syndrome with a cerebellar malformation as a major feature

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。
